lines.vo: Taking a walk can make your brain way more creative.
That's not wasting time, that's warming up your ideas.
Jay adds a ten minute walk to his Daily Habit Builder.
lines.cap: Jay adds a 10-minute walk to his Daily Habit Builder.

lines.vo: In Stanford studies, people listed creative uses for everyday objects.
While walking, their creative output rose about sixty percent on average.
lines.cap: While walking, their creative output rose about 60% on average.

lines.vo: Even walking on a treadmill facing a blank wall worked.
But for focused tasks with one right answer, walking didn't really help.
Walk to brainstorm, sit down to finish. That's how you stay on track.
